extracted.intended_audience: GAP users and developers working with group actions and permutations (mathematicians, computational group theorists, package authors)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for GAP operations and requirements concerning group actions, orbits, stabilizers, external sets and permutations; intended to guide correct use and extension of the group actions functionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action on canonical representatives
rubrics_metrics.description: A variety of action functions assumes that the objects on which it acts are given in a particular form, for example canonical representatives. Affected actions include OnSetsSets, OnSetsDisjointSets, OnSetsTuples, OnTuplesSets, OnLines and OnSubspacesByCanonicalBasis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If orbit seeds or domain elements are not given in the required form GAP will issue an error "Action not well-defined. See the manual section 'Action on canonical representatives'". To fix interactively, bring domain elements into canonical form (e.g. act with identity element). A user-defined action that does not implement a right action can trigger a similar error.

rubrics_metrics.name: Orbit
rubrics_metrics.description: Orbit(G[, Omega], pnt[, gens, acts][, act]) computes the orbit of the point pnt as the list of all images of pnt under elements of G with respect to action act (or OnPoints if no action is given).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The arrangement/order of points in the returned list is not defined. The orbit will always contain one element equal to pnt, but for performance reasons this element may not be identical to the given pnt if pnt is mutable. See Section 41.2 for specific actions. Examples in the manual illustrate usage with permutations and set/tuple actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Orbits
rubrics_metrics.description: Orbits(G, seeds[, gens, acts][, act]) / Orbits(G) / Orbits(xset) returns a duplicate-free list of the orbits of elements in seeds under act (or OnPoints if omitted).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For permutation groups, Orbits(G) returns orbits of the natural action. Arrangement of orbits or points within orbits is not defined by the operation. Example: a group with generators (1,2,3) and (4,5) has orbits {1,2,3} and {4,5}.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrbitsDomain
rubrics_metrics.description: OrbitsDomain(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) returns a list of the orbits of G on the domain Omega (given as lists) under act (or OnPoints if omitted).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This operation is often faster than Orbits. The domain Omega must be closed under the action of G; otherwise an error can occur. For permutation groups OrbitsDomain(G) returns orbits of natural action on moved points. Examples show use with lists, arrangements and vector spaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrbitLength
rubrics_metrics.description: OrbitLength(G[, Omega], pnt[, gens, acts][, act]) computes the length of the orbit of pnt under action act (or OnPoints if omitted).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when only the size of the orbit is needed. See examples for tuples/actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrbitLengths
rubrics_metrics.description: OrbitLengths(G, seeds[, gens, acts][, act]) / OrbitLengths(G) / OrbitLengths(xset) computes lengths of all orbits of elements in seeds under action act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For permutation groups, OrbitLengths(G) returns lengths of all orbits of the natural action. Example: group 〈(1,2,3),(5,6)〉 has orbit lengths 2 and 3.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrbitLengthsDomain
rubrics_metrics.description: OrbitLengthsDomain(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) computes the lengths of all orbits of G on Omega.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often faster than OrbitLengths; Omega must be closed under action of G or an error can occur. For permutation groups, OrbitLengthsDomain(G) returns lengths of orbits of natural action. Examples illustrate usage with arrangements and lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stabilizer concept
rubrics_metrics.description: The stabilizer of a point x under action of G is the set of elements of G which fix x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stabilizers are subgroups of G; standard methods use orbit-stabilizer algorithms; for permutation groups backtrack algorithms are used; solvable groups use specialized orbit-stabilizer exploiting normal subgroup block systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrbitStabilizer
rubrics_metrics.description: OrbitStabilizer(G[, Omega], pnt[, gens, acts][, act]) computes the orbit and stabilizer of pnt simultaneously using an orbit-stabilizer algorithm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stabilizer will have G as its parent. Useful when both orbit and stabilizer are required; example shows returned record {orbit, stabilizer} and parent relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stabilizer operation
rubrics_metrics.description: Stabilizer(G[, Omega], pnt[, gens, acts][, act]) computes the subgroup of G fixing pnt under the given action; stabilizer has G as parent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can compute stabilizer of sets or tuples by specifying appropriate action (OnSets, OnTuples). Example shows different stabilizers depending on action. Parent of returned stabilizer is G.

rubrics_metrics.name: OrbitStabilizerAlgorithm (internal extension point)
rubrics_metrics.description: OrbitStabilizerAlgorithm(G, Omega, blist, gens, acts, pntact) performs an orbit-stabilizer algorithm and is documented for extending or maintaining the group actions package; it should not be called by a user.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The pntact record may carry a component stabsub (a subgroup stabilizing all points) to abbreviate stabilizer calculations; pntact.onlystab boolean true may omit orbit in result. Omega may be false to be ignored; blist is a bit list corresponding to Omega to track already found elements and to stop if orbit cannot grow; useful when Omega is an enumerator and PositionCanonical is fast. This operation is intended for package authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: RepresentativeAction
rubrics_metrics.description: RepresentativeAction(G[, Omega], d, e[, gens, acts][, act]) computes an element of G mapping d to e under the given action and returns fail if none exists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard method uses orbit-stabilizer algorithm; for permutation groups/backtrack algorithms. Works with points, tuples, sets and even subgroups (returns element mapping one subgroup to another when possible). Examples show returns and fail cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permutation image via action homomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: ActionHomomorphism(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act][, "surjective"]) computes a homomorphism from G into the symmetric group on |Omega| points giving the permutation action of G on Omega.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result undefined if G does not act on Omega. By default homomorphism is not necessarily surjective to avoid computing image; if optional string "surjective" is given, a surjective homomorphism is created (computes range). A third compatibility version returns the action homomorphism belonging to image obtained via Action. PositionCanonical is used when acting on enumerators or representative sets. Examples show Image, Size(Range(hom)) differences and effect of "surjective".

rubrics_metrics.name: Action (image group)
rubrics_metrics.description: Action(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) returns the image group of ActionHomomorphism called with same parameters (the permutation image group).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: to get the action homomorphism the image group internally stores it; for extremely big G or Omega this can cause memory problems — in that case compute generator images yourself and form the image group to avoid memory blow-up. Examples show regular action creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: SparseActionHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: SparseActionHomomorphism(G, start[, gens, acts][, act]) computes the action homomorphism using the union of G-orbits of points in start; comparisons use only equality \= tests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when group acts on a very large domain non-surjectively to obtain a permutation image of smaller degree. It only uses \= comparisons so it can be used if no good < comparison exists; image may depend on generator choice. Use SortedSparseActionHomomorphism to sort orbit and obtain image independent of generators.

rubrics_metrics.name: RegularActionHomomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: RegularActionHomomorphism(G) returns an isomorphism from G onto the regular permutation representation of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when regular representation is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: FactorCosetAction (action on cosets)
rubrics_metrics.description: FactorCosetAction(G, U[, N]) computes action of G on right cosets of subgroup U; if normal subgroup N given it is stored as kernel of action. When second arg is list of subgroups, computes action isomorphic to subdirect product of the coset actions (degree reduction may occur if some actions are redundant).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correspondence of points with cosets depends on method used and is not guaranteed to match RightTransversal/RightCosets. Examples illustrate StructureDescription(Range(last)).

rubrics_metrics.name: AbelianSubfactorAction
rubrics_metrics.description: AbelianSubfactorAction(G, M, N) returns [phi, alpha, bas] when M ≥ N are normal under G and M/N is elementary abelian: bas are representatives for a basis of M/N, alpha maps M to a row space over GF(p) representing quotient, and phi is a homomorphism from G into GL(n,p) representing action on M/N.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If only matrices needed, LinearActionLayer might be faster. Examples show returned mapping, matrices and preimage representative usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permutation (single element permutation image)
rubrics_metrics.description: Permutation(g, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) computes the permutation corresponding to action of g on permutation domain Omega (a list of objects that are permuted). If external set given, permutation domain is HomeEnumerator of that external set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returned permutation's points refer to positions in Omega even if Omega consists of integers. If g does not leave domain invariant or does not map domain injectively, fail is returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: PermutationCycle
rubrics_metrics.description: PermutationCycle(g, Omega, pnt[, act]) computes the permutation that represents the cycle of pnt under action of element g.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when one cycle's permutation is required. Example shows permutation computed on a list representing GF(3)^2 and cycle examples on integer intervals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: Cycle(g, Omega, pnt[, act]) returns a list of the points in the cycle of pnt under g.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct listing of points in the cycle; see CycleLength for size.

rubrics_metrics.name: CycleLength
rubrics_metrics.description: CycleLength(g, Omega, pnt[, act]) returns the length of the cycle of pnt under g.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for counting cycle length without enumerating the cycle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cycles
rubrics_metrics.description: Cycles(g, Omega[, act]) returns a list of cycles (as lists of points) of the action of g on Omega.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cycle decomposition output; order of cycles unspecified.

rubrics_metrics.name: CycleLengths
rubrics_metrics.description: CycleLengths(g, Omega[, act]) returns the lengths of all cycles of g acting on Omega.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives multiset/list of cycle lengths; examples illustrate typical outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: CycleIndex for permutation and group
rubrics_metrics.description: CycleIndex(g, Omega[, act]) and CycleIndex(G, Omega[, act]) compute cycle index polynomial: z(g) = product over k of s_k^{c_k} and Z(G) = (sum_{g in G} z(g)) / |G| with indeterminates 1..n over rationals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indeterminates are x_1..x_n (Indeterminate). Example gives explicit cycle index for a transitive group of degree 6.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsTransitive
rubrics_metrics.description: IsTransitive(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) / IsTransitive(G) / IsTransitive(xset) returns true if the implied action is transitive (for every pair d,e in D there exists g in G with dg = e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For permutation groups, IsTransitive(G) tests natural action on moved points. If G does not act on given domain, appropriate false or error results may occur (examples show false when domain not invariant). See Section 41.1 for inputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transitivity degree
rubrics_metrics.description: Transitivity(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) / Transitivity(G) / Transitivity(xset) returns largest integer k such that the action is k-transitive; returns 0 if not transitive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An action is k-transitive if every k-tuple can be mapped to every other k-tuple. For permutation groups, Transitivity(G) returns degree for natural action.

rubrics_metrics.name: RankAction
rubrics_metrics.description: RankAction(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) / RankAction(xset) returns the rank of the transitive action (number of orbits of any point stabilizer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only meaningful for transitive actions. Example shows RankAction on combinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSemiRegular
rubrics_metrics.description: IsSemiRegular(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) / IsSemiRegular(G) returns true if action is semiregular (stabilizer of each point is the identity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For permutation groups, IsSemiRegular(G) tests natural action. Example: a group generated by disjoint 3-cycles is semiregular on moved points.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRegular
rubrics_metrics.description: IsRegular(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) / IsRegular(G) returns true if action is regular (both semiregular and transitive).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regular action implies one-to-one correspondence between G and Omega via a point. For permutation groups, IsRegular(G) tests natural action. Examples show true/false cases on arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earns (elementary abelian regular normals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Earns(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) / Earns(xset) returns list of elementary abelian regular normal subgroups of G (when acting on Omega).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At present only methods for primitive groups are implemented. Use when searching for regular elementary abelian normal subgroups.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPrimitive
rubrics_metrics.description: IsPrimitive(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) / IsPrimitive(G) / IsPrimitive(xset) returns true if action is primitive (transitive and admits no nontrivial block systems).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For permutation groups, IsPrimitive(G) uses natural action. For matrix groups the operation does not decide primitivity in the sense of preserving direct sum; use IsPrimitiveMatrixGroup or IRREDSOL package for that. See Section 41.11 for block systems. Examples illustrate usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blocks
rubrics_metrics.description: Blocks(G, Omega[, seed][, gens, acts][, act]) / Blocks(xset[, seed]) computes a block system for the transitive action of G on Omega. If seed omitted and action is imprimitive, a minimal nontrivial block system is found. If seed given, computes block system with seed as subset of one block.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result undefined if action not transitive. Examples show Blocks and Blocks with seed. See Section 41.2 for specific actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: MaximalBlocks
rubrics_metrics.description: MaximalBlocks(G, Omega[, seed][, gens, acts][, act]) returns a block system maximal with respect to inclusion for the transitive action of G on Omega; if seed given, block containing seed is computed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result undefined if action not transitive. Example shows returned maximal block partition.

rubrics_metrics.name: RepresentativesMinimalBlocks
rubrics_metrics.description: RepresentativesMinimalBlocks(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) computes a list of block representatives for all minimal nontrivial block systems for transitive action of G on Omega.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result undefined if action not transitive. Example returns list of representatives (each starting with point 1).

rubrics_metrics.name: AllBlocks (for permutation groups)
rubrics_metrics.description: AllBlocks(G) computes a list of representatives of all block systems for a permutation group G acting transitively on its moved points. Each representative is sorted and contains the smallest point moved by G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for exhaustive listing of block systems for transitive permutation groups. Example shows list of many block representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stabilizer of a block via OnSets
rubrics_metrics.description: The stabilizer of a block can be computed via the action OnSets: Stabilizer(g, block, OnSets) returns the subgroup preserving the block.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To return the largest subgroup preserving a partition bs given as set of sets, use Stabilizer(g, bs, OnSetsDisjointSets). Example demonstrates both uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: External sets and G-sets concept
rubrics_metrics.description: An external set specifies a G-set: a set Omega endowed with an action of G. External sets store ActingDomain, FunctionAction and HomeEnumerator attributes and are always unions of orbits; currently Omega must be finite. If Omega is not a list, an enumerator is chosen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most action operations are applicable as attributes for an external set. Many group subsets (conjugacy classes, cosets) are implemented as external orbits. External sets underlie action homomorphisms (UnderlyingExternalSet) and may have canonical representatives if determinator exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExternalSet constructor
rubrics_metrics.description: ExternalSet(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) creates external set for action act of G on Omega. Omega can be a set, a domain represented as per 12.4 and 30, or an enumerator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result is undefined if G does not act on Omega. Examples show ExternalSet created from list of group elements or the group itself with OnRight action.

rubrics_metrics.name: ActingDomain attribute
rubrics_metrics.description: ActingDomain(xset) returns the group with which external set xset was defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to recover the acting group for an external set; example given.

rubrics_metrics.name: FunctionAction attribute
rubrics_metrics.description: FunctionAction(xset) returns the acting function with which external set xset was defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare to action constants like OnRight; example shows equality check FunctionAction(e) = OnRight returning true.

rubrics_metrics.name: HomeEnumerator attribute
rubrics_metrics.description: HomeEnumerator(xset) returns an enumerator of the action domain with which external set xset was defined (may differ from Enumerator(xset) which enumerates only the subset).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when needing the underlying enumeration order of the whole action domain; examples illustrate returned lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsExternalSubset and ExternalSubset
rubrics_metrics.description: IsExternalSubset(obj) categorizes an external subset (restriction of an external set to an invariant subset). ExternalSubset(G, Omega, start[, gens, acts], act) constructs the external subset on union of orbits of points in start; undefined if G does not act on Omega.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External subsets are external sets; use start to specify orbits to include. Examples and definitions provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsExternalOrbit and ExternalOrbit
rubrics_metrics.description: IsExternalOrbit(obj) identifies external subset consisting of one orbit. ExternalOrbit(G, Omega, pnt[, gens, acts], act) constructs external subset on orbit of pnt; Representative value of this external set is pnt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result undefined if G does not act on Omega. Example shows notation (1,2,3)^G for an external orbit.

rubrics_metrics.name: StabilizerOfExternalSet
rubrics_metrics.description: StabilizerOfExternalSet(xset) computes stabilizer of Representative(xset) value of external set xset; stabilizer will have acting group of xset as parent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when working with external orbits/sets; examples show Representative and StabilizerOfExternalSet usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExternalOrbits and ExternalOrbitsStabilizers
rubrics_metrics.description: ExternalOrbits(G, Omega[, gens, acts][, act]) / ExternalOrbits(xset) computes list of external orbits giving orbits of G. ExternalOrbitsStabilizers additionally computes stabilizers of representatives of external orbits and can be faster than computing ExternalOrbits then stabilizers separately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show returned external orbit notation and ability to query HasStabilizerOfExternalSet and StabilizerOfExternalSet on returned items.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanonicalRepresentativeOfExternalSet
rubrics_metrics.description: CanonicalRepresentativeOfExternalSet(xset) attribute: canonical representative of an external set xset may only depend on defining attributes G, Omega, act and (for subsets) Enumerator(xset).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GAP does not know methods for arbitrary external sets to compute canonical representative; see CanonicalRepresentativeDeterminatorOfExternalSet. Canonical rep must not depend on representative of an external orbit.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanonicalRepresentativeDeterminatorOfExternalSet
rubrics_metrics.description: CanonicalRepresentativeDeterminatorOfExternalSet(xset) returns a function that given acting group and a point returns a list of length 1 or 3: first entry canonical representative and other entries (if bound) stabilizer of canonical rep and a conjugating element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An external set is only guaranteed to compute canonical representative if it has such a determinator. This is an extension point for package authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: ActorOfExternalSet
rubrics_metrics.description: ActorOfExternalSet(xset) returns an element mapping Representative(xset) to CanonicalRepresentativeOfExternalSet(xset) under the given action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example demonstrates retrieving ActorOfExternalSet and applying FunctionAction to map representative to canonical representative.

rubrics_metrics.name: UnderlyingExternalSet
rubrics_metrics.description: UnderlyingExternalSet(acthom) returns the external set on which an action homomorphism acthom was defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to get back the domain / enumerator used to build an action homomorphism; examples show printing the underlying external set.

rubrics_metrics.name: SurjectiveActionHomomorphismAttr
rubrics_metrics.description: SurjectiveActionHomomorphismAttr(xset) returns an action homomorphism for external set xset which is surjective; computing this may take substantially longer because the Image/Range must be computed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when a surjective action homomorphism is required and you accept the additional computation time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permutations data type and storage considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: GAP stores permutations as lists of images of integers 1..d where d is internal degree (largest integer moved or bigger). Images stored as 16-bit or 32-bit integers depending on whether d ≤ 65536. On 32-bit systems limit is 2^28-1; on 64-bit limit is 2^32-1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reading cycle notation d is set to largest moved integer; multiplication may increase internal degree without shortening, causing identity calculated from long cycle to have large internal degree and large memory. RestrictedPerm reduces storage degree to save memory. Permutations do not belong to a specific group; one can work with permutations without defining containing group. Error messages should occur if commands would need creating a permutation exceeding system limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPerm (category test)
rubrics_metrics.description: IsPerm is the category test function for permutations (used to test whether an object is a permutation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 42.1.1 and surrounding discussion on permutation storage and arithmetic. Other permutation utilities (Permuted) reorder list entries by permutation.
